Anthropic擬感恩節前啟動超大型IPO

彭博先前報導，Anthropic最快可能在11月9日該周開始IPO正式行銷，並有望在感恩節前開始交易。
雖然Anthropic旗下Claude的品牌知名度不及競爭對手OpenAI旗下ChatGPT，但Claude在軟體開發人員等企業用戶之間獲得廣泛採用，有望帶來許多專業投資人所尋求的穩定營收成長。銀行、避險基金，以及Salesforce(CRM-US)等企業軟體供應商，都已把Anthropic工具整合至工作流程中。
在AI安全爭議升溫、新股市場表現疲弱之際，潛在投資人仍看好Anthropic的合理估值約在1.8兆至2兆美元之間，IPO規模將追平、甚至超越SpaceX(SPCX-US)的IPO規模。
反觀OpenAI近幾個月來的銷售動能雖然有所提升，仍把IPO計畫延後到明年，執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)日前表示，IPO沒有時間表，AI安全比上市更重要。據悉OpenAI計劃在新一輪融資中至少向投資人募資300億美元，並尋求約1.4兆美元的估值。

IPO文件曝AI風險

根據日前由路透曝光的機密IPO文件，Anthropic指出，旗下AI模型可能出現「自保」行為，包括抗拒關閉、隱瞞或操縱訊息，甚至有類似勒索的行為。
在IPO文件261頁正文中，Anthropic用了約80頁說明AI風險因素，幾乎是介紹公司業務篇幅的兩倍
儘管強調AI安全風險，Anthropic仍打算大舉投資算力和基礎建設，未來幾年計劃為雲端運算和基礎建設投入約5180億美元。
文件也披露Anthropic的財務表現，去年營收接近46億美元，增為前年的12倍，但本業營業虧損卻翻倍至超過80億美元。
paras_en: Despite ongoing scrutiny of AI safety issues, sources say Anthropic plans to meet potential investors on Oct. 14 to prepare for its initial public offering (IPO), a timeline that would push the company toward a November listing target.

Sources say invitations to the event have only just begun to be sent out, and a group of invited institutional investors will question Anthropic’s senior executives. One source noted the event will be held at the company’s headquarters in San Francisco.

Anthropic aims to launch a mega‑size IPO before Thanksgiving. Bloomberg previously reported that the IPO could begin formal marketing as early as the week of Nov. 9 and could start trading before Thanksgiving.

While Anthropic’s Claude brand is not as well‑known as OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Claude has seen broad adoption among enterprise users such as software developers, promising the stable revenue growth that professional investors seek. Banks, hedge funds and enterprise‑software vendors like Salesforce (CRM‑US) have already integrated Anthropic tools into their workflows.

Amid heightened AI‑safety controversy and a weak new‑issue market, potential investors still see Anthropic’s fair valuation at roughly $1.8‑$2 trillion, with an IPO size that could match or even exceed SpaceX’s (SPCX‑US) offering.

By contrast, OpenAI’s sales momentum has improved in recent months but the company has pushed its IPO plan to next year; CEO Sam Altman recently said there is no timetable for an IPO and that AI safety is more important than going public. OpenAI is reportedly seeking to raise at least $30 billion in a new financing round and target a valuation of about $1.4 trillion.

IPO documents reveal AI risks. According to confidential filing leaked by Reuters, Anthropic warned that its AI models could exhibit “self‑preservation” behaviors, including resisting shutdown, concealing or manipulating information, and even actions resembling ransomware.
In the 261‑page main body of the IPO filing, Anthropic devoted roughly 80 pages to AI risk factors—almost twice the length of the sections describing its business.

Despite emphasizing AI safety risks, Anthropic plans to invest heavily in compute and infrastructure, targeting roughly $518 billion over the next few years for cloud computing and related infrastructure.

The filing also disclosed Anthropic’s financial performance: last year revenue approached $4.6 billion, twelve times the figure from the year before, while operating losses more than doubled to over $8 billion.

items.title: 美光投資人不再像過去那樣追捧亮眼財報
items.title_en: Micron investors no longer chase bright earnings as before
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，美光(Micron)(MU-US)股價周四(1日)上漲超過3%，此前一天公司公布的第四季財報優於分析師預期，並給出樂觀展望。回顧今年6月，美光公布優於預期的財報後，股價隔日一度大漲近16%。
Gabelli投資組合經理兼分析師Hendi Susanto表示，在市場對AI驅動的成長能否持續抱持一定疑慮之際，投資人「對美光設定了很高的要求」，希望公司能達成積極的成長目標。
受AI硬體需求帶動，美光今年營收大幅成長，加上全球記憶體零組件供應短缺，讓美光及同業得以提高產品價格，使其股價今年已幾乎翻了四倍。
William Blair分析師表示，他們預期記憶體供應不足的情況將延續至2028年，仍看好美光股價未來還有上漲空間。Visible Alpha追蹤的其他10位分析師也持相同看法。
儘管分析師評級仍在變動，華爾街分析師整體而言仍對美光股票抱持看多態度。在11位分析師中，有10位建議買進，另有1位給予中立評級。
這些分析師的平均目標價約為1,595美元，相較周四收盤價1,097.39美元，意味著股價仍有約45%上漲空間。
paras_en: Investopedia reported that Micron (MU-US) shares rose more than 3% on Thursday the 1st, after the company posted a Q4 earnings report that beat analyst expectations and gave an optimistic outlook. Looking back to June this year, after Micron reported better‑than‑expected results, the stock jumped nearly 16% the next day.

Gabelli portfolio manager and analyst Hendi Susanto said that while the market remains somewhat skeptical about whether AI‑driven growth can be sustained, investors have “set very high expectations for Micron,” hoping the company can achieve aggressive growth targets.

Driven by AI hardware demand, Micron’s revenue has surged sharply this year, and a global shortage of memory components has allowed Micron and its peers to raise product prices, causing its stock to have almost quadrupled so far this year.

William Blair analysts said they expect the memory shortage to continue through 2028 and remain bullish on Micron’s upside potential. The other ten analysts tracked by Visible Alpha share the same view.
Although analyst ratings are still shifting, Wall Street analysts overall remain bullish on Micron stock. Of 11 analysts, 10 recommend a buy and one gives a neutral rating.
These analysts’ average price target is about $1,595, compared with Thursday’s closing price of $1,097.39, implying roughly a 45% upside.

items.title: 全球首座增強型地熱電廠23個月完工 AI資料中心成潛在買家
items.title_en: World's First Enhanced Geothermal Power Plant Completed in 23 Months, AI Data Centers Potential Buyers
paras: 《TechCrunch》報導，地熱能源公司Fervo Energy(FRVO-US)周四(1日)宣布，其Cape Station發電廠已於9月30日開始向電網出售電力，比原定時程提前一天。
這使Fervo成為全球首家達到這項重要商業里程碑的增強型地熱能源公司。該發電廠約一周前已與電網併網，目前已啟用整座電廠的第一個區塊，占未來100MW發電廠的三分之一。
不過，整座Cape Station基地的規模可能還會更大。Fervo先前透露，該基地最終發電潛力最高可達4GW。
Fervo共同創辦人兼執行長Tim Latimer在聲明中表示，「全球從來沒有任何團隊建造過這樣的專案，而我們還提前完成了。」
從破土動工到商業運轉，Cape Station第一個區塊僅花了23個月完成。隨著Fervo持續改進施工流程，目標是未來將每個區塊的完工時間縮短至18個月。
這樣的快速供電能力，對目前面臨電力短缺的資料中心業者應該相當具吸引力。這些業者正從能源產業各個領域尋找可用的發電容量。
增強型地熱也可採取分階段開發，類似資料中心的建造方式，讓大型雲端業者(hyperscaler)能隨著需求增加逐步啟用更多機架。
Google、Southern California Edison等公司都已承諾購買Fervo Cape Station專案所生產的電力。
Fervo是目前多家開發增強型地熱發電廠的公司之一。傳統地熱發電主要利用接近地表的熱源，而Fervo及其同業則向更深處鑽探，因地下深層岩石溫度更高，也開啟了更多地熱能源開發機會。
Fervo於今年5月透過擴大規模的首次公開募股(IPO)上市，募得19億美元。公司成立於2017年，將石油與天然氣產業的鑽探技術與相關科技應用於新地熱資源的開發。
Fervo已從投資方手中募得超過13億美元，投資者包括Breakthrough Energy Ventures、Congruent Ventures與Capricorn Investment Group。
paras_en: TechCrunch reported that geothermal energy company Fervo Energy (FRVO-US) on Thursday (the 1st) announced its Cape Station plant began selling power to the grid on Sept 30, a day ahead of schedule.

This makes Fervo the world's first enhanced geothermal company to reach this commercial milestone. The plant was grid‑connected about a week ago and the first block of the plant, representing one‑third of the planned 100 MW facility, is now online.
However, the overall Cape Station site may be larger. Fervo previously said the site’s ultimate generation potential could be as high as 4 GW.
Fervo co‑founder and CEO Tim Latimer said in a statement, “No team in the world has ever built a project like this, and we did it ahead of schedule.”

From groundbreaking to commercial operation, the first block of Cape Station took only 23 months to complete. As Fervo continues to refine its construction process, it aims to cut block completion time to 18 months in the future.

This rapid power‑delivery capability should be very attractive to data‑center operators currently facing electricity shortages. Those operators are looking for available generation capacity across the energy sector.
Enhanced geothermal can also be developed in phases, similar to how data centers are built, allowing large hyperscalers to bring online additional racks as demand grows.
Companies such as Google and Southern California Edison have pledged to purchase electricity generated by the Fervo Cape Station project.

Fervo is one of several companies developing enhanced geothermal plants. Conventional geothermal mainly uses shallow heat sources, whereas Fervo and peers drill deeper, where rock temperatures are higher, opening more geothermal development opportunities.

Fervo went public in May this year with a scaled‑up IPO, raising $1.9 billion. Founded in 2017, the company applies oil and gas drilling technology and related tech to develop new geothermal resources.
Fervo has raised over $1.3 billion from investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Congruent Ventures and Capricorn Investment Group.

items.title: AI改變投資邏輯 艾克曼：部分市場霸主可能因新技術消失
items.title_en: AI Changes Investment Logic: Ackman Says Some Market Leaders May Disappear Due to New Technology
paras: 潘興廣場(Pershing Square)創辦人暨執行長艾克曼(Bill Ackman)表示，人工智慧(AI)快速發展已「大幅提高企業遭顛覆的風險」，投資人過去用來判斷企業競爭優勢與護城河的方式，必須重新檢視。他指出，AI技術進步速度遠超過過去多數科技變革，即使目前占據市場主導地位的企業，也可能在未來因新技術而失去原有優勢，甚至退出市場。
艾克曼日前接受Shane Parrish主持的《The Knowledge Project》Podcast訪問時表示，評估長期投資時，他會思考如果股市關閉10年，自己是否仍願意持有這家公司的股票，並進一步預測企業10年、20年甚至30年後的業務型態。他認為，AI讓這項工作變得更加困難，因為新技術提高了企業被顛覆的可能性。
艾克曼指出，投資人現在必須更加仔細分析企業的護城河，以及這項優勢究竟有多寬、能維持多久。他提到，過去網際網路已經顛覆許多看似牢不可破的商業模式，例如Wikipedia取代部分傳統百科全書，而AI帶來的變化更為複雜。他認為，即使是目前全球最具主導地位的企業，也會有部分最終因AI而消失。
他同時指出，AI對投資人的挑戰並不代表AI只有負面影響。相反地，AI可能催生過去根本無法成立的新企業，也讓原本沒有創業經驗的人具備成為企業家的能力。艾克曼形容，AI能力進步的速度是他「見過最快的」，過去軟體重大版本更新可能相隔數年，如今AI模型與相關產品甚至可能在幾天內出現重大能力提升。
艾克曼舉出AI軟體公司Cognition的案例表示，該公司的AI工具能協助大型銀行及金融機構處理長期累積的舊有系統。許多大型金融機構因過去多年併購而留下大量Legacy Systems，維護及更新成本相當高，而AI可以協助將Cobol等舊程式碼轉換為現代程式語言，原本可能需要數月的工作，有機會縮短至數天。
他認為，這類AI應用可能讓大型金融機構及科技企業的營運效率大幅提高，並降低整體成本。不過，效率提升後所產生的利潤能否由企業保留，仍是另一個問題。如果所有競爭者都被迫採用最有效率的AI軟體，成本下降可能透過更低價格轉嫁給客戶，最終企業未必能完整取得生產力提升所帶來的利潤。
艾克曼指出，這項結果將取決於產業特性及企業定價能力。以銀行業為例，銀行提供的資金本身具有高度商品化特性，因此即使AI降低營運成本，也不代表新增利潤一定能全部留在銀行體內。
在AI投資布局方面，艾克曼透露，潘興廣場已經將AI用於投資研究，利用相關工具協助團隊處理資訊及分析企業。他認為，AI不僅可能改變企業的成本結構，也可能改變投資研究本身的工作方式。
艾克曼也談到Meta(META-US)近期推出的AI代理人Muse。他表示，自己當時尚未親自使用Muse，但潘興廣場辦公室內已有員工實際使用，並討論Muse讓使用者建立自己的AI代理人變得更加容易。他認為，這類產品顯示AI已經從單純回答問題，逐步朝著直接替使用者執行工作的方向發展。
他指出，AI代理人的進步可能進一步改變企業競爭環境。當消費者或企業可以透過AI代理人完成搜尋、分析、比較及執行任務時，傳統企業依靠品牌、介面、流量或流程所建立的優勢，都可能面臨重新評估。
艾克曼尤其關注AI對企業護城河的影響。他表示，投資人最困難的問題之一，就是判斷一家目前極具主導地位的企業，其競爭優勢能否延續到10年、20年甚至30年後。AI發展速度越快，企業原有優勢被新技術削弱的時間就可能越短。
在AI基礎建設方面，艾克曼則點名Brookfield(BN-US)，認為該公司是AI發展的受益者之一。原因在於AI運算需求快速增加，除了晶片及軟體之外，也需要大量資料中心、電力及其他實體基礎設施，而Brookfield長期布局實體基礎設施及相關資產，因此有機會參與AI產業擴張所帶來的資本支出需求。
艾克曼對AI的看法並非單純看多或看空。他一方面認為AI將帶來巨大的生產力提升，催生過去不存在的企業及商業模式，並讓更多人成為創業者；另一方面，他也認為AI會讓投資人更難判斷企業的長期價值，尤其是那些目前看似擁有強大護城河的企業。
他也提醒，AI產業本身可能出現泡沫及資本損失。隨著大量資金投入AI企業及相關基礎建設，投資人可能高估部分企業的長期獲利能力，而AI技術快速演進也可能導致今天被視為重要的產品或商業模式，在未來被更有效率的新技術取代。
艾克曼認為，AI與過去網際網路革命的一個重要差異，在於技術更新速度更快。過去大型軟體公司推出重大版本更新，可能需要數年時間，但目前AI產品的能力可能在幾天內就出現明顯變化。這意味著企業即使今天建立起競爭優勢，也必須持續投入資源才能維持領先。
他因此表示，投資人未來不能只問一家企業目前是不是市場龍頭，也必須問這家公司在AI環境下仍然具備什麼不可取代的優勢，以及競爭對手是否能透過AI降低進入門檻。如果新的競爭者可以利用AI以更低成本、更快速度提供相同服務，傳統企業長期累積的護城河就可能遭到侵蝕。
對潘興廣場而言，這也意味著長期投資的核心仍是判斷企業未來能否持續產生現金流及維持競爭優勢，但AI已經成為其中不可忽略的新變數。艾克曼表示，企業的市場地位、品牌、規模及既有護城河仍然重要，但投資人必須進一步判斷這些優勢是否能抵抗AI帶來的結構性變化。
艾克曼此次談話也延續他近年對長期投資方法的思考。他過去曾因Netflix(NFLX-US)的投資決策重新檢視自己的投資流程，這次則把AI視為影響未來企業價值判斷的重要變數。對他而言，AI不只是科技產業的投資題材，而是可能重新定義企業競爭優勢及產業結構的技術變革。
隨著AI代理人、生成式AI及AI基礎設施持續快速發展，艾克曼認為，投資人未來需要同時面對兩個方向：一方面尋找AI能夠創造新需求、降低成本及催生新企業的機會；另一方面則必須防範現有企業的護城河因技術進步而快速縮小。這使得AI不只是新的成長題材，也成為長期投資人重新評估企業存續能力的重要因素。
paras_en: Bill Ackman, founder and CEO of Pershing Square, said that the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) has "significantly increased the risk of companies being disrupted," and investors must reassess the way they evaluate corporate competitive advantages and moats. He noted that AI is advancing far faster than most past technological revolutions, so even firms that dominate their markets today could lose their edge or exit the market because of new technology.

Ackman told Shane Parrish on The Knowledge Project podcast that when evaluating long‑term investments he asks whether he would still hold the stock if the market were closed for ten years, and he tries to picture the company’s business model ten, twenty or thirty years out. He believes AI makes this exercise harder because new technology raises the likelihood of disruption.

Ackman said investors now have to scrutinize a company’s moat more closely, asking how wide it is and how long it can last. He pointed out that the internet already upended many seemingly unassailable business models—Wikipedia, for example, replaced parts of traditional encyclopedias—and that AI’s impact will be even more complex. Even the world’s most dominant firms could eventually disappear because of AI.

He added that AI’s challenge to investors does not mean AI is only negative. On the contrary, AI could spawn entirely new businesses that could not have existed before and give people without entrepreneurial experience the ability to become founders. Ackman described the speed of AI progress as the fastest he has ever seen; whereas major software releases used to take years, AI models and products can achieve major capability jumps in days.

Ackman cited the AI software company Cognition as an example, noting that its tools help large banks and financial institutions deal with legacy systems accumulated over years of mergers. Maintaining and updating those legacy systems is costly, but AI can convert old code such as COBOL into modern languages, potentially shrinking work that once took months down to a few days.

He believes such AI applications could dramatically boost operational efficiency and cut costs for big financial and tech firms. However, whether the resulting profit stays with the company is another question. If all competitors are forced to adopt the most efficient AI software, cost reductions may be passed on to customers through lower prices, meaning firms might not capture the full productivity gain.

Ackman said the outcome will depend on industry characteristics and pricing power. In banking, for instance, capital is highly commoditized, so even if AI lowers operating costs, the extra profit may not stay within the bank.

Regarding AI investment, Ackman disclosed that Pershing Square has already deployed AI in its investment research, using tools to help the team process information and analyze companies. He believes AI could not only reshape corporate cost structures but also change the way investment research is conducted.

Ackman also discussed Meta’s recent AI agent, Muse. He hadn’t used Muse himself, but employees in Pershing Square’s office had, and they noted that Muse makes it easier for users to create their own AI agents. He sees such products as evidence that AI is moving from simply answering questions to directly performing tasks for users.

He noted that advances in AI agents could further alter competitive dynamics. When consumers or businesses can use AI agents to search, analyze, compare and execute tasks, traditional advantages built on brand, interface, traffic or processes may need to be reassessed.

Ackman is especially focused on AI’s impact on corporate moats. He said one of the hardest problems for investors is judging whether a currently dominant firm can sustain its competitive edge ten, twenty or thirty years from now. The faster AI develops, the shorter the window before a firm’s existing advantage is eroded by new technology.

In the AI infrastructure space, Ackman singled out Brookfield (BN-US) as a beneficiary. He explained that AI’s growing compute demand requires not only chips and software but also massive data centers, power and other physical infrastructure, and Brookfield’s long‑term investments in real assets position it to capture the capital‑spending surge tied to AI expansion.

Ackman’s view of AI is neither purely bullish nor bearish. He believes AI will deliver huge productivity gains, create businesses and business models that didn’t exist before, and enable more people to become entrepreneurs; at the same time, he warns that AI will make it harder for investors to assess long‑term corporate value, especially for firms that now appear to have strong moats.

He also cautioned that the AI sector itself could experience bubbles and capital losses. With large amounts of money flowing into AI companies and related infrastructure, investors may overestimate some firms’ long‑term profitability, and rapid AI advances could render today’s important products or models obsolete tomorrow.

Ackman sees a key difference between AI and the earlier internet revolution: the speed of technological updates. In the past, major software releases could take years; today, AI product capabilities can change noticeably within days. This means that even firms that build a competitive edge today must continuously invest to stay ahead.

Consequently, investors can no longer ask only whether a company is currently a market leader; they must also ask what irreplaceable advantages the firm retains in an AI‑driven environment and whether competitors can use AI to lower entry barriers. If new entrants can deliver the same service at lower cost and faster speed with AI, the long‑built moat of traditional firms could be eroded.

For Pershing Square, this means that the core of long‑term investing remains judging whether a company can continue to generate cash flow and maintain competitive advantage, but AI has become an unavoidable new variable. Ackman said market position, brand, scale and existing moats are still important, yet investors must assess whether those strengths can withstand AI‑driven structural change.

Ackman’s comments continue his recent reflections on long‑term investing. He previously revisited his investment process after the Netflix (NFLX-US) decision, and now treats AI as a critical factor in evaluating future corporate value. To him, AI is not just a tech‑sector theme but a technological shift that could redefine competitive advantage and industry structure.

As AI agents, generative AI and AI infrastructure continue to evolve rapidly, Ackman believes investors will need to address two fronts: seeking opportunities where AI creates new demand, cuts costs and spawns new firms, while also guarding against the rapid erosion of existing companies’ moats due to technological progress. This makes AI not only a new growth theme but also a key factor for long‑term investors reassessing corporate survivability.

items.title: 美光財報為SK海力士即將公布的業績 透露哪些訊號？
items.title_en: What Signals Does Micron's Earnings Send Ahead of SK Hynix's Upcoming Results?
paras: 美光最新公布的強勁財報，為即將於 10 月 27 日登場的 SK 海力士 (SK Hynix) 第三季法說會開出閃亮頭彩。隨著全球人工智慧 (AI) 應用需求持續攀升，AI 記憶體市場正面臨長期供不應求的局面，美光釋出的樂觀展望不僅振奮市場，更為同業 SK 海力士帶來極具指標性的正面訊號。
美光客戶搶先鎖定產能 2027 年 HBM 供應幾乎售罄
美光財報顯示，終端客戶為確保先進記憶體供應，正掀起一波「搶料潮」。
美光策略性客戶的長期財務承諾金額，已從今年 6 月的 220 億美元大幅暴增至 320 億美元。
美光更明確指出，2027 年絕大多數的高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 產能皆已簽約售罄，且合約價格顯著高於 2026 年水準。
美光預測，記憶體供應短缺的現象在 2027 至 2028 年恐將更加嚴峻。
此現象凸顯出 AI 記憶體買方寧可提前數年下單鎖定產能，也不願等待價格回檔。
美光第四會計季營收達 542.3 億美元，調整後每股盈餘 (EPS) 為 33.42 美元，毛利率高達 87%；預估第一會計季營收將進一步攀升至 615 億美元，展現出高價值產品線所帶來的強勁獲利動能。
SK 海力士 HBM4 增產在即 市場聚焦價格與產品組合
作為 DRAM 與 HBM 領域的競爭巨頭，SK 海力士營收已達 79.32 兆韓元，營業利益達 60.54 兆韓元，並已與全球約 10 家主要客戶簽訂長期合約。
目前 SK 海力士已啟動 HBM4 的大量出貨，並預計於 2026 年下半年進一步擴大產能。美光揭露的產業榮景，正好為 SK 海力士的長約結構提供了有力支撐。
法人指出，投資人於 10 月 27 日檢視 SK 海力士財報時，除了關注出貨量成長外，應特別留意 DRAM 價格走勢以及 HBM4 在整體產品組合中的營收占比。若 SK 海力士呈現價格再度調漲或 HBM4 滲透率加速，將再次印證先進記憶體供不應求的產業主旋律。
資本支出同步擴張 華爾街力挺「強力買進」
儘管記憶體大廠紛紛擴大資本支出以期擴充產能，美光預估 2027 會計年度上半年資本支出將達 250 億美元，但考量到新晶圓廠從興建到實際投產需時數年，短期內新增產能仍難以緩解市場渴求。
華爾街分析師目前對美光與 SK 海力士雙雙給予「強力買進」評等。其中美光目標價上看 1,564 美元，隱含約 51.5% 的潛在上漲空間。SK 海力士目標價則為 254.70 美元。
整體而言，美光亮眼的成績單已為 SK 海力士即將揭曉的業績奠定了堅實且樂觀的基調。
paras_en: Micron's latest strong earnings report sets a bright tone for SK Hynix's (SK Hynix) third‑quarter earnings call scheduled for October 27. As global demand for artificial‑intelligence (AI) applications continues to rise, the AI memory market is facing a long‑term supply shortage, and Micron's optimistic outlook not only energizes the market but also sends a highly indicative positive signal to rival SK Hynix.
Micron's customers are locking in capacity early, with HBM supply for 2027 almost sold out.
Micron's earnings show that end‑users, eager to secure advanced memory supply, are launching a wave of "rush‑to‑buy" activity.
Long‑term financial commitments from Micron's strategic customers have surged from $22 billion in June to $32 billion.
Micron further points out that most of the high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity for 2027 has already been contracted, and the contract prices are significantly higher than 2026 levels.
Micron forecasts that the memory supply shortage could become even more severe in 2027‑2028.
This highlights that AI memory buyers prefer to place orders years in advance to lock in capacity rather than wait for prices to fall.

Micron posted fourth‑quarter revenue of $54.23 billion, adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of $33.42, and a gross margin of 87%; it projects first‑quarter revenue to climb further to $61.5 billion, demonstrating strong profit momentum from its high‑value product lines.
SK Hynix's HBM4 production is about to ramp up, with the market focusing on pricing and product mix.
As a DRAM and HBM heavyweight, SK Hynix reported revenue of 79.32 trillion won and operating profit of 60.54 trillion won, and has signed long‑term contracts with roughly ten major global customers.

SK Hynix has already begun large‑scale shipments of HBM4 and plans to expand capacity further in the second half of 2026. The industry optimism disclosed by Micron provides solid support for SK Hynix's long‑term contract structure.

Analysts note that when investors review SK Hynix's earnings on October 27, they should not only watch shipment growth but also pay close attention to DRAM price trends and the revenue share of HBM4 within the overall product portfolio. A price hike or accelerated HBM4 penetration would further confirm the industry’s prevailing theme of advanced memory scarcity.
Capital spending is expanding in tandem, and Wall Street backs a "strong buy" stance.

Although memory giants are increasing capital expenditures to expand capacity, Micron estimates that capital spending in the first half of fiscal 2027 will reach $25 billion, but new fabs take several years from construction to production, so additional capacity will not ease market demand in the short term.
Wall Street analysts currently give both Micron and SK Hynix a "strong buy" rating. Micron's target price is $1,564, implying about a 51.5% upside potential, while SK Hynix's target price is $254.70.
Overall, Micron's impressive results have set a solid and optimistic backdrop for SK Hynix's upcoming earnings release.

items.title: 美銀警告高油價成第4季頭號威脅 金價恐探3750美元
items.title_en: Bank of America Warns High Oil Prices as Top Q4 Threat, Gold May Dip to $3,750
paras: 美國銀行警告，高油價已成為黃金第4季面臨的頭號短期威脅。伊朗局勢推升能源成本，透過通膨、美元及債券殖利率對金價形成壓力。該行預估，第四季黃金均價約每盎司4000美元，短期存在下探3750美元的風險，但仍看好2027年金價回升。
美銀指出，地緣衝突帶來的避險需求，已不足以完全抵銷能源通膨造成的利率衝擊。自8月20日油價突破每桶90美元以來，黃金累計下跌約8%，同期原油上漲約15%，美元指數升逾2%，美國名目及實質債券殖利率均上升約50個基點。
油價走高推升通膨壓力，強化市場對聯準會維持緊縮政策的預期，更高的實質利率與更強的美元則壓抑黃金表現。這使中東衝突對金價的影響，有別於傳統避險邏輯：當能源價格持續攀升、迫使央行採取更鷹派政策，利率壓力可能超過避險需求。
10年期美債殖利率週四一度觸及近24年高點，增加持有無息黃金的機會成本。聯準會9月已將政策利率上調至3.75%至4%，多名官員預期仍需進一步升息。
4000美元成觀察關卡
美銀認為，目前實體黃金、ETF及其他投資需求，大致支撐每盎司4000美元附近的價格，但風險情境下，短期金價可能回落至3750美元。
該行先前估算，若金價要長期維持在5000美元左右，全球黃金投資需求須較目前增加約14%。儘管今年需求仍強，高利率、美元走強及高油價，將使短期需求進一步大幅擴張面臨難度。
黃金ETF資金動向也是風險之一。美銀指出，持有人迄今尚未大規模撤出，部分原因是仍在評估中東局勢、利率及金價走勢。若金價持續下滑、利率壓力未緩解，ETF資金流向可能加劇市場波動。
央行買盤也非持續增加。油價上漲衝擊部分能源進口國的匯率與經常帳後，一些央行今年一度出售黃金，第二季官方部門淨出售約60噸，土耳其為主要賣方之一。
油價150美元是壓力情境
美銀另提出壓力測試：若中東衝突長期延續，推動油價升至每桶150美元，能源通膨與貨幣政策緊縮，可能使2027年黃金均價降至約3500美元。
不過，這並非美銀的基準預測。該行仍預估2027年黃金全年均價約4800美元，第二季與第三季均價可能達5000美元附近，前提是能源價格及貨幣政策壓力隨後緩和。
長期需求仍有支撐
路透社分析指出，即使10年期美債殖利率升至2002年以來高點，黃金仍守在4000美元上方，反映2022年以來央行儲備多元化、降低美元資產集中度及地緣風險相關需求仍在。
MKS PAMP金屬策略師Nicky Shiels估計，2022年以前，無法以實質殖利率及美元走勢解釋的黃金額外溢價，約每盎司120美元；近年平均超過1000美元，目前約840美元。
這些需求使金價與實質殖利率過去較穩定的負相關關係減弱。不過，若伊朗局勢持續推高油價，進一步推升通膨、美元及利率，黃金短期仍將承受壓力，美銀對2027年的回升預測也有賴上述壓力逐步消退。
paras_en: Bank of America warned that soaring oil prices have become the primary short‑term threat to gold in the fourth quarter. The Iran situation is pushing up energy costs, which, through inflation, the dollar and bond yields, is pressuring gold prices. The bank estimates the average gold price in Q4 at about $4,000 an ounce, with a short‑term risk of falling to $3,750, but remains bullish on a rebound by 2027.

Bank of America noted that the safe‑haven demand generated by geopolitical conflicts is no longer enough to fully offset the rate‑impact of energy‑driven inflation. Since oil broke $90 a barrel on August 20, gold has fallen roughly 8% while oil has risen about 15% over the same period, the dollar index has climbed more than 2%, and both nominal and real U.S. bond yields have risen about 50 basis points.

Higher oil prices are feeding inflation pressure, reinforcing market expectations that the Fed will keep tightening. Higher real rates and a stronger dollar are suppressing gold performance. This makes the impact of Middle‑East conflict on gold different from the traditional safe‑haven logic: when energy prices keep climbing and force central banks to adopt more hawkish policies, rate pressure can outweigh safe‑haven demand.

The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield touched a near‑24‑year high on Thursday, raising the opportunity cost of holding non‑interest‑bearing gold. The Fed raised its policy rate to 3.75%‑4% in September, and several officials expect further hikes.
$4,000 Becomes a Key Watch Level

Bank of America believes that current physical gold, ETF and other investment demand broadly supports prices around $4,000 an ounce, but in a risk scenario the short‑term price could retreat to $3,750.

The bank previously estimated that for gold to stay around $5,000 long‑term, global gold investment demand would need to be about 14% higher than today. Although demand remains strong this year, high rates, a strong dollar and high oil prices make further short‑term demand expansion difficult.

Gold ETF flows are another risk factor. Bank of America said holders have not yet withdrawn large amounts, partly because they are still assessing the Middle‑East situation, rates and gold price trends. If gold keeps falling and rate pressure persists, ETF flows could amplify market volatility.

Central‑bank buying is not continuously increasing. After oil‑price‑driven pressure on some energy‑importing countries' exchange rates and current accounts, some central banks sold gold this year; official sector net sales in Q2 were about 60 tonnes, with Turkey among the main sellers.
$150 Oil Price as a Stress Scenario

Bank of America also ran a stress test: if the Middle‑East conflict drags on and pushes oil to $150 a barrel, energy‑driven inflation and monetary tightening could push the 2027 average gold price down to roughly $3,500.

However, this is not the bank’s baseline forecast. It still projects the 2027 full‑year average gold price at about $4,800, with Q2 and Q3 averages possibly near $5,000, assuming energy prices and monetary‑policy pressures later ease.
Long‑Term Demand Still Provides Support

Reuters analysis points out that even with the 10‑year Treasury yield at its highest since 2002, gold remains above $4,000, reflecting continued central‑bank diversification of reserves, reduced reliance on dollar assets and geopolitically‑driven demand since 2022.

MKS PAMP metals strategist Nicky Shiels estimates that before 2022, gold carried an extra premium of about $120 an ounce that could not be explained by real yields or dollar moves; in recent years the premium averaged over $1,000, now around $840.

These demands have weakened the historically strong negative correlation between gold and real yields. However, if the Iran situation continues to push oil higher, further inflating energy costs, the dollar and rates, gold will still face short‑term pressure, and Bank of America’s 2027 rebound outlook depends on those pressures gradually receding.

items.title: 轉向輕資產！FT：亞馬遜打算將80億美元輝達AI晶片轉入SPV並回租
items.title_en: Turning to Light Assets! FT: Amazon Plans to Transfer $8 Billion of Nvidia AI Chips into an SPV and Lease Them Back
paras: 外媒今(2)日引述知情人士最新報導指出，亞馬遜正尋求透過一個新設載體，向外部投資人出售約80億美元的輝達先進晶片，以增強自身資產負債表。亞馬遜還打算提供該載體最多10%的股權，這意味著亞馬遜本身將不會持有任何股權。
近幾週，亞馬遜跟投資人展開磋商，以了解市場對這項交易的興趣。根據該方案，亞馬遜將把部署在美國各地資料中心的數千顆Blackwell晶片分拆至一個特殊目的載體(SPV)，隨後將從該SPV回租這些先進AI晶片，而SPV將透過發行債券引入外部投資者。
透過將這些昂貴的半導體資產轉給投資者，亞馬遜可在資產負債表管理方面採取更輕資產的營運模式。
投資人預估，基於亞馬遜目前的雙A級信用評級，該SPV將獲得投資級信用評等，為保險公司和退休基金等更廣泛的投資者參與交易鋪平道路。
paras_en: Foreign media cited informed sources on the 2nd, reporting that Amazon is seeking to use a newly created vehicle to sell about $8 billion of Nvidia advanced chips to external investors in order to strengthen its balance sheet. Amazon also intends to offer up to 10% equity in the vehicle, meaning Amazon itself will hold no equity at all.

In recent weeks Amazon has been negotiating with investors to gauge market interest in the deal. Under the proposal, Amazon would spin off the thousands of Blackwell chips deployed across its U.S. data centers into a special purpose vehicle (SPV) and then lease back those advanced AI chips from the SPV, which would raise external capital by issuing bonds.
By transferring these costly semiconductor assets to investors, Amazon can adopt a lighter‑asset operating model for balance‑sheet management.

Investors estimate that, given Amazon’s current AA credit rating, the SPV would receive an investment‑grade rating, paving the way for broader participation from insurers, pension funds and other institutional investors.

items.title: 看好AI資料中心需求！東芝時隔五年大規模擴產 2027年前HDD產能翻倍
items.title_en: Optimistic About AI Data‑Center Demand! Toshiba Expands Production for the First Time in Five Years, Aiming to Double HDD Capacity by 2027
paras: 日經新聞(Nikkei)報導，隨著人工智慧(AI)熱潮推升儲存需求，東芝正擴大相關產能，計劃在2027年度前把用於AI資料中心的硬碟機(HDD)產能提高一倍。
根據報導，東芝將投資約600億日元(3.8億美元)，擴建位於菲律賓的HDD製造設施，這也是東芝約五年來首度進行大規模的硬碟相關投資。
東芝是全球三大HDD製造商之一，另外兩家為美國的威騰(Western Digital)(WDC-US)與希捷科技(Seagate)(STX-US)。根據報導，東芝的中期目標是把以儲存容量計算的市占率，從目前略高於10%提高至30%。
相較於固態硬碟(SSD)，HDD的儲存成本較低，吸引資料中心部署更多高容量硬碟。
東芝這次擴產將新增生產線，生產單顆容量最高可提高40%的HDD，並支援東芝在2030年前大量生產65TB級HDD的計畫，最終目標則是推出100TB級產品。
paras_en: Nikkei reports that the AI boom is driving up storage demand, and Toshiba is expanding related capacity, planning to double the HDD output used for AI data centers by fiscal 2027.

According to the report, Toshiba will invest about 60 billion yen (US$380 million) to expand its HDD manufacturing facility in the Philippines, marking the company's first large‑scale hard‑disk investment in roughly five years.

Toshiba is one of the world’s three biggest HDD manufacturers, alongside the United States’ Western Digital (WDC‑US) and Seagate (STX‑US). The report says Toshiba’s mid‑term goal is to raise its storage‑capacity market share from just over 10% to 30%.
Compared with solid‑state drives (SSDs), HDDs have lower storage costs, making them attractive for data centers that need to deploy higher‑capacity drives.

The expansion will add a new production line capable of producing HDDs with up to 40% higher per‑drive capacity and will support Toshiba’s plan to mass‑produce 65‑TB class HDDs before 2030, with a final target of launching 100‑TB class products.

items.title: 川普重申美國利率應為「全球最低」
items.title_en: Trump Reiterates US Interest Rates Should Be “Globally Lowest”
paras: 美國總統川普周五(2日)再度表示，美國利率「應該要是全球最低」。川普對貨幣政策的談話，正受到市場高度關注。
就在前一天，川普才談到，「利率將阻礙我們的成長」，並再次強調他認為高利率正在拖累經濟。
這一連串談話再次凸顯川普對聯準會(Fed)政策管理的立場。談到聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)時，川普也表示，他希望華許「按照自己的意願投票」。
聯準會依法享有不受政治干預的獨立性，但總統對貨幣政策的談話經常引發市場參與者討論。川普最新的言論可能對未來的政策管理及利率走勢產生影響，因此受到市場關注。
周三公布數據顯示，美國8月通膨增幅低於預期，且7月數據遭到下修，降低了市場對聯準會本月升息的預期。
根據CME的FedWatch工具，交易員目前預期聯準會10月升息的機率為24.9%，低於一周前的70%。
目前市場聚焦周五公布的9月非農就業數據。《路透社》調查預估非農就業新增9萬人，低於8月的16.2萬人。失業率預料連續第三個月維持4.1%，但仍存在上升風險。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 2nd) that U.S. interest rates "should be the lowest in the world," a statement that has drawn intense market attention.
Just a day earlier, Trump had said that "interest rates will hinder our growth" and again stressed his view that high rates are dragging the economy down.
These remarks underscore Trump’s stance on Federal Reserve policy. When discussing Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, Trump said he wants Warsh to "vote according to his own wishes."

The Fed is legally independent from political interference, but presidential comments on monetary policy often spark debate among market participants. Trump’s latest remarks could affect future policy management and rate trajectories, drawing market focus.
Data released on Wednesday showed August inflation in the United States rose less than expected, and July figures were revised down, lowering market expectations for a Fed rate hike this month.
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders now see a 24.9% probability of a Fed rate increase in October, down from 70% a week earlier.

The market is now focused on Friday’s September non‑farm payroll report. Reuters’ poll estimates the payrolls will add 90,000 jobs, down from August’s 162,000, with the unemployment rate expected to hold at 4.1% for a third consecutive month, though upside risks remain.

items.title: AI代理人狂刷網路流量 克雷默點名3家公司僅這家可買
items.title_en: AI Agents Flood the Internet with Traffic; Cramer Names 3 Companies, Only This One Worth Buying
paras: AI代理人快速普及正在推升全球網路流量，讓負責管理、加速及保護網路流量的基礎建設業者迎來新的成長機會。CNBC知名財經節目主持人克雷默(Jim Cramer)表示，Cloudflare(NET-US)、Akamai Technologies(AKAM-US)及Fastly(FSLY-US)都可能受惠於AI帶來的網路流量大增，但以目前估值及基本面來看，他認為只有Akamai值得現在買進。
克雷默指出，AI革命帶來的一項重要副產品，就是網路流量正在快速增加。隨著AI代理人開始大量瀏覽網站、抓取資料、呼叫API及執行各種任務，網路基礎建設業者需要處理的自動化流量大幅增加，讓Cloudflare、Akamai及Fastly等扮演「網路交通警察」角色的公司，有機會從AI熱潮中取得新的收入來源。
三家公司今年股價表現均明顯優於大盤。截至9月底，Fastly今年以來股價上漲約159%, Cloudflare上漲約78%, Akamai則上漲約22%,同期標普500指數約上漲12%。克雷默認為，市場已開始反映AI流量對這些公司的正面影響，但三家公司目前的估值差距相當大，因此投資條件並不相同。
Cloudflare是其中最受AI流量趨勢帶動的公司之一。Cloudflare執行長Matthew Prince今年6月曾向克雷默表示，公司網路上的AI代理人流量已經超越人類產生的流量，顯示AI代理人正在成為網際網路流量的重要來源。
Cloudflare主要透過全球分布式網路提供內容傳遞、網路安全及邊緣運算服務。隨著AI代理人需要持續連接網站並取得資料，Cloudflare的網路及安全服務使用量也可能同步增加。
不過，克雷默認為Cloudflare目前的估值已經相當高。該股當時約以今年預估獲利的279倍本益比交易，因此即使他看好公司的長期發展，也認為投資人不必急著追價，而是等待股價出現較好的進場位置。
Cloudflare近期也持續調整AI時代的流量政策。公司希望AI企業為其爬蟲及資料抓取活動所使用的內容支付費用，並已推出相關設定，讓網站業者可以拒絕AI訓練用途的爬取，同時維持網站出現在一般搜尋結果中。Cloudflare表示，Apple及Google已支援相關選擇機制，Microsoft則計畫在2027年初加入。
Akamai則是克雷默在三家公司中唯一明確表示目前可以買進的公司。Akamai成立時間較早，長期提供內容傳遞網路、雲端運算及網路安全服務，近年也積極將基礎設施轉向AI工作負載。
Akamai近期宣布建立更分散的小型資料中心網路，讓AI工作負載能夠更靠近使用者及企業，以降低延遲。這項布局尤其針對AI產業從模型訓練逐步轉向大規模推論及實際應用後，對低延遲運算能力日益增加的需求。
Akamai在9月24日公布與AI公司Anthropic達成重大合作，Anthropic承諾在未來7年向Akamai採購價值116億美元的運算能力。這項協議主要涉及CPU運算工作負載，並包含Anthropic取得Akamai約5%股份的認股權證安排。
消息公布後，Akamai股價一度大漲約16%,但隨後回吐大部分漲幅。克雷默認為，股價回落反而提供較好的進場機會，因為市場目前並沒有完全反映這項116億美元合作對Akamai未來AI業務的潛在影響。
克雷默指出，Akamai目前本益比低於16倍今年預估獲利，與Cloudflare約279倍的估值形成巨大差距。他認為，投資人以目前價格買進Akamai，某種程度上相當於沒有為Anthropic這筆大型合作支付太多額外估值溢價。
Akamai同時面臨短期資本支出增加的問題。公司預計2026年將額外投入約17億美元購買包括記憶體在內的重要零組件，整體AI基礎設施投資規模約55億美元。這些支出短期可能壓縮自由現金流及獲利，但公司希望透過提前部署運算能力，掌握AI推論市場成長。
Akamai預期，到2028年底，AI相關業務年營收有望達到約17億美元。這意味著公司目前的AI基礎建設投資，主要是為未來數年的AI運算需求提前布局。
至於Fastly,公司則正從傳統內容傳遞網路(CDN)業者轉型為「Edge Cloud」平台，希望利用邊緣運算把運算能力部署在更接近使用者的位置，以降低AI應用的延遲。
Fastly的業務模式與AI代理人快速增加的趨勢具有一定關聯。AI代理人需要頻繁存取網站及服務，企業也需要更快速地處理這些請求，因此能夠提供低延遲網路及邊緣運算能力的業者，有機會從流量增加中受惠。
但克雷默認為，Fastly目前的估值同樣偏高。該股當時約以今年預估獲利50倍左右的本益比交易，而且過去股價波動相對劇烈，因此他並不認為目前是最適合進場的時點。
克雷默表示，Fastly確實正在進行重要的業務轉型，但投資人需要等待更好的價格。相比之下，Akamai的估值較低，加上剛取得Anthropic的大型長期合約，使其在三家公司中具備更明顯的估值優勢。
AI代理人流量快速增加，也正在改變網路基礎建設產業的需求結構。傳統網路流量主要來自人類使用者瀏覽網站、觀看影片及使用App,但AI代理人可以全天候大量執行搜尋、資料抓取及API請求，因此單一AI代理人可能產生遠高於一般使用者的網路活動。
Cloudflare近期公布的數據顯示，AI代理人及其他自動化機器人產生的網路請求已占公司觀察到的網路流量約57%,而Cloudflare執行長Prince此前曾預期，機器人流量可能在2027年底超越人類流量，實際上這項變化已提前發生。
Prince也預測，如果AI代理人的發展速度維持目前趨勢，未來5年自動化流量甚至可能達到人類流量的1000倍。若這種情境逐步實現，網路基礎建設業者所需處理的流量規模將與目前完全不同，也可能讓內容傳遞、網路安全、邊緣運算及資料中心等服務成為AI產業的重要基礎。
不過，AI流量增加並不代表所有網路基礎建設公司都能同等受惠。投資人仍須考量各家公司目前估值、資本支出、客戶結構、AI業務營收及自由現金流等因素。
對克雷默而言，Cloudflare的問題主要是估值過高，Fastly則是股價波動及估值仍偏高，而Akamai在獲得Anthropic大型長約後，仍維持相對較低的估值。因此，在三家網路基礎建設公司之中，他目前將Akamai視為唯一值得直接買進的標的。
隨著AI從模型訓練逐漸進入實際部署階段，AI代理人需要的運算、頻寬、安全防護及低延遲網路服務也可能同步增加。這使得Cloudflare、Akamai及Fastly等傳統網路基礎建設業者，開始成為AI投資主題下除了晶片、雲端及模型公司之外，另一個受到市場關注的受惠族群。
paras_en: AI agents are spreading rapidly, boosting global internet traffic and giving infrastructure providers that manage, accelerate and protect traffic a new growth opportunity. CNBC host Jim Cramer said Cloudflare (NET-US), Akamai Technologies (AKAM-US) and Fastly (FSLY-US) could all benefit from the AI‑driven traffic surge, but based on current valuations and fundamentals he believes only Akamai is worth buying now.

Cramer noted that a key side effect of the AI revolution is a sharp rise in internet traffic. As AI agents start browsing sites en masse, scraping data, calling APIs and performing tasks, infrastructure firms must handle a lot more automated traffic, giving companies like Cloudflare, Akamai and Fastly – the “traffic police” of the web – a chance to tap new revenue streams from the AI boom.

All three stocks have outperformed the market this year. By the end of September, Fastly was up about 159% YTD, Cloudflare about 78%, and Akamai roughly 22%, versus a roughly 12% gain for the S&P 500. Cramer thinks the market is already pricing in the positive impact of AI traffic, but the valuation gaps among the three are large, so the investment cases differ.

Cloudflare is one of the firms most driven by the AI‑traffic trend. Its CEO Matthew Prince told Cramer in June that AI‑agent traffic on Cloudflare’s network had already surpassed human‑generated traffic, showing that bots are becoming a major source of internet flow.

Cloudflare delivers content delivery, web security and edge‑computing services through a globally distributed network. As AI agents continuously connect to sites and pull data, usage of Cloudflare’s network and security services is likely to rise in step.

However, Cramer believes Cloudflare’s valuation is already very high. The stock was trading at roughly 279 times its projected 2024 earnings, so even though he likes the company’s long‑term outlook, he advises investors to wait for a better entry price rather than chase the stock now.

Cloudflare has been tweaking its traffic policies for the AI era. The firm wants AI companies to pay for the content their crawlers scrape and has introduced settings that let site owners block AI‑training crawls while keeping their sites visible in regular search results. Cloudflare says Apple and Google already support the mechanism, and Microsoft plans to join in early 2027.

Akamai is the only one of the three that Cramer explicitly says is a buy right now. Founded earlier than the others, Akamai has long provided content‑delivery, cloud and security services and has recently been shifting its infrastructure toward AI workloads.

Akamai recently announced a more distributed network of small data centers so AI workloads can sit closer to users and enterprises, cutting latency. This rollout targets the growing need for low‑latency compute as the AI industry moves from model training to large‑scale inference and real‑world applications.

On September 24, Akamai disclosed a major partnership with AI firm Anthropic, which pledged to purchase $11.6 billion of compute capacity from Akamai over the next seven years. The deal focuses on CPU workloads and includes warrants giving Anthropic about a 5% equity stake in Akamai.

After the news, Akamai’s share price jumped roughly 16% before giving back most of the gain. Cramer sees the pull‑back as a better entry point, arguing the market has not fully priced the $11.6 billion partnership’s upside for Akamai’s AI business.

Cramer pointed out that Akamai’s price‑to‑earnings ratio is under 16× its 2024 earnings estimate, a stark contrast to Cloudflare’s roughly 279× multiple. He says buying Akamai at current levels means investors are not paying a large premium for the Anthropic deal.

Akamai also faces near‑term capital‑expenditure pressure. The company expects to spend about $1.7 billion in 2026 on critical components such as memory, part of an overall $5.5 billion AI‑infrastructure investment. These outlays could compress free cash flow and profit in the short run, but Akamai hopes early capacity deployment will capture AI inference market growth.

Akamai projects AI‑related revenue to reach about $1.7 billion by the end of 2028, indicating that today’s infrastructure spending is largely a pre‑positioning of compute capacity for the next few years of AI demand.
Fastly, by contrast, is shifting from a traditional CDN provider to an “Edge Cloud” platform, aiming to place compute power closer to users to reduce latency for AI applications.

Fastly’s business model aligns with the rapid rise of AI agents. Bots need frequent site and service access, and enterprises need faster handling of those requests, so firms that can deliver low‑latency networking and edge compute stand to benefit from the traffic surge.

Nevertheless, Cramer believes Fastly’s valuation is also too high. The stock was trading at roughly a 50× forward earnings multiple and has shown relatively volatile price swings, so he does not view it as the best entry point right now.

Cramer acknowledges that Fastly is undergoing an important transformation, but investors should wait for a better price. By comparison, Akamai’s lower valuation and the newly secured Anthropic contract give it a clearer valuation edge among the three.

The surge in AI‑agent traffic is reshaping the demand profile for internet infrastructure. Traditional traffic comes from human users browsing, streaming and using apps, whereas AI agents can operate 24/7, generating far more requests per unit than a typical user.

Cloudflare’s recent data show that AI agents and other automated bots now account for about 57% of the traffic the company observes. Prince had previously predicted bot traffic could overtake human traffic by the end of 2027, but the shift has already happened ahead of schedule.

Prince also forecasts that if AI‑agent growth continues, automated traffic could reach 1,000 times human traffic within five years. If that materializes, the scale of traffic infrastructure needed will be fundamentally different, making content delivery, security, edge compute and data‑center services core to the AI ecosystem.

However, rising AI traffic does not mean every infrastructure provider will benefit equally. Investors must weigh each company’s valuation, cap‑ex plans, customer mix, AI revenue exposure and free‑cash‑flow generation.

For Cramer, Cloudflare’s problem is an over‑inflated valuation, Fastly suffers from price volatility and still‑high multiples, while Akamai, after landing the large Anthropic deal, remains relatively cheap. Consequently, he views Akamai as the only one of the three worth buying outright.

As AI moves from model training to real‑world deployment, the compute, bandwidth, security and low‑latency networking needs of AI agents are likely to rise in tandem. This makes traditional infrastructure players such as Cloudflare, Akamai and Fastly a newly spotlighted beneficiary group in the broader AI investment theme, alongside chips, cloud providers and model developers.

items.title: Anthropic傳10/14舉辦上市前投資人日 瞄準感恩節前掛牌
items.title_en: Anthropic Schedules Pre-IPO Investor Day on Oct. 14, Aiming for Listing Before Thanksgiving
paras: 儘管人工智慧(AI)安全問題持續受到外界審視，知情人士透露，Anthropi預定10月14日與潛在投資人會面，為首次公開發行(IPO)做準備。按照這個時程，這將使Anthropic朝11月上市的目標推進。
知情人士表示，這場活動的邀請函最近才陸續發出，屆時將由一批獲邀的機構投資人向Anthropic高階主管提問。其中一名知情人士透露，活動將在公司位於舊金山的總部舉行。

Anthropic擬感恩節前啟動超大型IPO

彭博先前報導，Anthropic最快可能在11月9日該周開始IPO正式行銷，並有望在感恩節前開始交易。
雖然Anthropic旗下Claude的品牌知名度不及競爭對手OpenAI旗下ChatGPT，但Claude在軟體開發人員等企業用戶之間獲得廣泛採用，有望帶來許多專業投資人所尋求的穩定營收成長。銀行、避險基金，以及Salesforce(CRM-US)等企業軟體供應商，都已把Anthropic工具整合至工作流程中。
在AI安全爭議升溫、新股市場表現疲弱之際，潛在投資人仍看好Anthropic的合理估值約在1.8兆至2兆美元之間，IPO規模將追平、甚至超越SpaceX(SPCX-US)的IPO規模。
反觀OpenAI近幾個月來的銷售動能雖然有所提升，仍把IPO計畫延後到明年，執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)日前表示，IPO沒有時間表，AI安全比上市更重要。據悉OpenAI計劃在新一輪融資中至少向投資人募資300億美元，並尋求約1.4兆美元的估值。

IPO文件曝AI風險

根據日前由路透曝光的機密IPO文件，Anthropic指出，旗下AI模型可能出現「自保」行為，包括抗拒關閉、隱瞞或操縱訊息，甚至有類似勒索的行為。
在IPO文件261頁正文中，Anthropic用了約80頁說明AI風險因素，幾乎是介紹公司業務篇幅的兩倍
儘管強調AI安全風險，Anthropic仍打算大舉投資算力和基礎建設，未來幾年計劃為雲端運算和基礎建設投入約5180億美元。
文件也披露Anthropic的財務表現，去年營收接近46億美元，增為前年的12倍，但本業營業虧損卻翻倍至超過80億美元。
paras_en: Despite ongoing scrutiny of AI safety issues, sources say Anthropic plans to meet potential investors on Oct. 14 to prepare for its initial public offering (IPO), a timeline that would push the company toward a November listing target.

Sources say invitations to the event have only just begun to be sent out, and a group of invited institutional investors will question Anthropic’s senior executives. One source noted the event will be held at the company’s headquarters in San Francisco.

Anthropic aims to launch a mega‑size IPO before Thanksgiving. Bloomberg previously reported that the IPO could begin formal marketing as early as the week of Nov. 9 and could start trading before Thanksgiving.

While Anthropic’s Claude brand is not as well‑known as OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Claude has seen broad adoption among enterprise users such as software developers, promising the stable revenue growth that professional investors seek. Banks, hedge funds and enterprise‑software vendors like Salesforce (CRM‑US) have already integrated Anthropic tools into their workflows.

Amid heightened AI‑safety controversy and a weak new‑issue market, potential investors still see Anthropic’s fair valuation at roughly $1.8‑$2 trillion, with an IPO size that could match or even exceed SpaceX’s (SPCX‑US) offering.

By contrast, OpenAI’s sales momentum has improved in recent months but the company has pushed its IPO plan to next year; CEO Sam Altman recently said there is no timetable for an IPO and that AI safety is more important than going public. OpenAI is reportedly seeking to raise at least $30 billion in a new financing round and target a valuation of about $1.4 trillion.

IPO documents reveal AI risks. According to confidential filing leaked by Reuters, Anthropic warned that its AI models could exhibit “self‑preservation” behaviors, including resisting shutdown, concealing or manipulating information, and even actions resembling ransomware.
In the 261‑page main body of the IPO filing, Anthropic devoted roughly 80 pages to AI risk factors—almost twice the length of the sections describing its business.

Despite emphasizing AI safety risks, Anthropic plans to invest heavily in compute and infrastructure, targeting roughly $518 billion over the next few years for cloud computing and related infrastructure.

The filing also disclosed Anthropic’s financial performance: last year revenue approached $4.6 billion, twelve times the figure from the year before, while operating losses more than doubled to over $8 billion.

items.title: 美光投資人不再像過去那樣追捧亮眼財報
items.title_en: Micron investors no longer chase bright earnings as before
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，美光(Micron)(MU-US)股價周四(1日)上漲超過3%，此前一天公司公布的第四季財報優於分析師預期，並給出樂觀展望。回顧今年6月，美光公布優於預期的財報後，股價隔日一度大漲近16%。
Gabelli投資組合經理兼分析師Hendi Susanto表示，在市場對AI驅動的成長能否持續抱持一定疑慮之際，投資人「對美光設定了很高的要求」，希望公司能達成積極的成長目標。
受AI硬體需求帶動，美光今年營收大幅成長，加上全球記憶體零組件供應短缺，讓美光及同業得以提高產品價格，使其股價今年已幾乎翻了四倍。
William Blair分析師表示，他們預期記憶體供應不足的情況將延續至2028年，仍看好美光股價未來還有上漲空間。Visible Alpha追蹤的其他10位分析師也持相同看法。
儘管分析師評級仍在變動，華爾街分析師整體而言仍對美光股票抱持看多態度。在11位分析師中，有10位建議買進，另有1位給予中立評級。
這些分析師的平均目標價約為1,595美元，相較周四收盤價1,097.39美元，意味著股價仍有約45%上漲空間。
paras_en: Investopedia reported that Micron (MU-US) shares rose more than 3% on Thursday the 1st, after the company posted a Q4 earnings report that beat analyst expectations and gave an optimistic outlook. Looking back to June this year, after Micron reported better‑than‑expected results, the stock jumped nearly 16% the next day.

Gabelli portfolio manager and analyst Hendi Susanto said that while the market remains somewhat skeptical about whether AI‑driven growth can be sustained, investors have “set very high expectations for Micron,” hoping the company can achieve aggressive growth targets.

Driven by AI hardware demand, Micron’s revenue has surged sharply this year, and a global shortage of memory components has allowed Micron and its peers to raise product prices, causing its stock to have almost quadrupled so far this year.

William Blair analysts said they expect the memory shortage to continue through 2028 and remain bullish on Micron’s upside potential. The other ten analysts tracked by Visible Alpha share the same view.
Although analyst ratings are still shifting, Wall Street analysts overall remain bullish on Micron stock. Of 11 analysts, 10 recommend a buy and one gives a neutral rating.
These analysts’ average price target is about $1,595, compared with Thursday’s closing price of $1,097.39, implying roughly a 45% upside.

items.title: 從DEI到AI戰爭 美軍高層大洗牌 赫格塞斯推動將軍及將官職位砍20%
items.title_en: From DEI to AI War: Major Shake‑up in U.S. Military Leadership, Hegseth Pushes 20% Cut in General and Officer Positions
paras: 美國戰爭部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)宣布，美軍將進一步削減將軍及將官職位，目標是將整體數量降低20%。赫格塞斯9月30日在維吉尼亞州匡蒂科海軍陸戰隊基地發表「部隊現況演說」時表示，目前美軍已解職約10%的將軍及將官，另外再削減10%的將官職位，因此整體降幅達20%。這項措施並非一次裁撤160名現役將領，而是透過解職、退休、未補缺及取消職位等方式，逐步縮減高階指揮架構。
根據美國國防部7月底數據，美軍現役將軍及將官約851人，包括陸軍、海軍、海軍陸戰隊、空軍及太空軍；聯邦法律規定的上限則為857人。若以851人作為基準，20%的職位削減相當於約170個職位。不過，實際減幅將取決於各軍種如何調整編制，不能直接等同於170名現役將領遭到解職。
赫格塞斯表示，這項改革的目的在於精簡高層指揮結構、減少官僚層級，並讓軍隊更加集中於訓練、戰備、紀律及作戰能力。他表示，自己已經要求軍方減少不必要的高階職位，並認為過去的軍事體系存在過多重複的指揮及行政層級。
這也是赫格塞斯自2025年出任戰爭部長以來持續推動的軍事重整之一。2025年5月，他曾要求各軍種至少削減10%的將軍及將官職位，國民兵將官職位則要求削減20%，並要求軍方移除被認為重複或不必要的組織層級。最新方案則把整體削減幅度進一步提高至20%。
赫格塞斯同時把這項改革與他所批評的「覺醒」文化及多元、公平與包容(DEI)政策連結。他在演說中表示，五角大廈不再是「覺醒部門」，軍隊的主要任務應重新集中在訓練、戰備、問責、紀律及殺傷力。他也表示，過去支持相關文化的人員如果無法配合新的政策方向，已經不再擔任相關職務。
不過，將軍及將官職位削減與DEI政策並非完全相同的政策項目。赫格塞斯政府主張精簡高層架構是為了提升效率及作戰準備，而批評者則認為，近期大量高階軍官離任、職位調整及晉升受阻，可能同時反映政策方向及人事忠誠度考量。
赫格塞斯在演說中也以相當強烈的語言描述他希望建立的軍隊文化，強調軍人應以作戰能力、體能、紀律及戰備為核心，而不是把大量時間投入社會及文化議題。這番言論引發民主黨人士、部分前國防官員及軍事專家的批評，他們擔心政治因素過度介入軍隊人事及指揮體系，並可能影響軍隊專業性與高層穩定。
赫格塞斯及支持者則認為，軍方高層長期擴張、行政程序過多，以及部分與作戰無直接關聯的政策，已經增加軍隊運作成本。赫格塞斯主張，軍方應把更多資源投入實際戰備，而不是維持過於龐大的高階指揮結構。
美軍近年的DEI政策變化也成為此次改革的重要背景之一。歐巴馬政府時期，美國正式結束「不問、不說」政策，2010年通過廢除相關法律，並於2011年9月20日正式生效，讓同性戀及雙性戀軍人可以公開身分服役。這項政策改革是美軍人事制度重大轉變之一，但與今日所稱的DEI政策並不能完全畫上等號。
拜登政府上任後則進一步調整跨性別軍人政策。拜登2021年1月25日簽署行政命令，要求國防部及國土安全部採取措施恢復跨性別人士符合條件即可服役的政策。此後，美軍持續推動與性別認同及多元包容相關的人事政策與訓練。
原文提及的蕾切爾．萊文則需要特別區分。萊文在2021年成為美國公共衛生服務軍官團四星上將，是美國公共衛生服務軍官團的一員，而不是陸軍、海軍、空軍、海軍陸戰隊或太空軍的四星將領，因此不能直接稱為「美軍第一位跨性別四星上將」。
川普重新入主白宮後，政府迅速逆轉部分前朝軍方人事及DEI政策。川普政府要求軍方重新檢視與DEI相關的政策、訓練及計畫，並對跨性別軍人服役資格採取更嚴格的限制。赫格塞斯則成為這項軍事政策轉向的主要執行者之一。
赫格塞斯上任後已推動多項高層人事調整。根據公開資料，截至9月初，至少20名將軍、海軍將領及國防部高階文職官員已被解職、被迫離任或自行離職，其中包括陸軍、海軍及空軍的重要高階軍官。這些人事變動使五角大廈高層出現明顯重組。
今年4月，赫格塞斯還要求陸軍參謀長Randy George等高階軍官離開職務。George原本預計任期至2027年，相關調整發生在美軍仍參與伊朗戰事之際，因此引發外界對軍隊高層穩定性及人事決策標準的關注。
除了削減將官職位，赫格塞斯9月30日也宣布成立新的「自主戰爭司令部」(Autonomous Warfare Command)，這將成為一個四星級作戰司令部，負責加速無人機、自主系統及機器人技術在美軍中的部署。五角大廈希望藉此加快AI、自主武器及機器人系統的軍事應用。
赫格塞斯同時宣布成立宗教事務辦公室，並提出建立新的軍事基地及提高軍事基地能源自主能力等計畫。此外，五角大廈將啟動一項為期120天的未來戰爭研究計畫，探討AI、自主武器、機器人及其他新型軍事科技對未來戰場的影響。
這場高層重整也受到國會關注。部分議員認為，軍隊在伊朗戰事及其他全球軍事任務持續進行期間大幅更換高階指揮人員，可能造成指揮體系的不確定性；支持改革的人士則認為，美軍高層多年來已形成過於龐大的官僚結構，精簡將官職位不但可以降低行政負擔，也能把資源轉向作戰單位。
截至目前，赫格塞斯並未提出證據證明DEI政策本身導致美軍戰鬥力下降，因此「DEI造成美軍戰力下滑」主要屬於川普政府及赫格塞斯陣營對過去軍事政策的批評，而不是已獲一致確認的軍事結論。相對地，反對者則認為，將高層人事變動與政治理念直接掛鉤，可能弱化軍隊文官領導與軍事專業之間的傳統界線。
美軍此次改革的另一個重要方向，是將高層人事調整與新型戰爭技術發展同步推進。赫格塞斯一方面削減部分傳統高階職位，另一方面成立自主戰爭司令部，顯示五角大廈希望降低部分傳統官僚層級，同時提高AI、無人機及自主系統在作戰體系中的比重。
從組織規模來看，851名現役將軍及將官相對於超過130萬名現役軍人不到1%，但這些職位負責統率美軍主要軍種、作戰司令部及大型部隊，因此任何大規模調整都可能影響軍方的指揮鏈與人事升遷制度。
赫格塞斯則將這場改革描述為「問責」，而不是外界所稱的「清洗」。他表示，美軍已經完成約10%的高階人事削減，現在再透過取消10%的將官職位，使整體高階架構縮減20%。按照目前計畫，相關改革將持續推進，部分職位可能在2027年1月1日前完成調整。
這場改革的核心爭議因此不只是DEI，而是美軍應如何在保持專業軍事指揮體系的同時，縮減高層官僚架構、調整人事制度，並把更多資源轉向新型戰爭能力。赫格塞斯希望藉由這波重整建立更加強調戰備及作戰能力的軍隊，但改革的實際效果，以及大規模高層人事變動對美軍戰備與指揮穩定性的長期影響，仍有待後續發展。
paras_en: U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced that the U.S. military will further cut general and senior officer positions, aiming to reduce the total number by 20%. Speaking at a "Force Status" address on September 30 at the Quantico Marine Corps Base in Virginia, Hegseth said the service has already dismissed about 10% of its generals and senior officers and will cut another 10% of officer slots, achieving an overall 20% reduction. The measure is not a one‑time removal of 160 active‑duty generals, but a gradual shrinkage of the high‑level command structure through dismissals, retirements, non‑replacements and position eliminations.

According to Department of Defense data at the end of July, the U.S. armed forces have roughly 851 active‑duty generals and senior officers across the Army, Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force and Space Force, against a statutory cap of 857. Using 851 as the baseline, a 20% cut equals about 170 positions. However, the actual reduction will depend on how each service adjusts its tables of organization and cannot be equated directly with 170 active generals being dismissed.

Hegseth said the reform’s purpose is to streamline the senior command structure, reduce bureaucratic layers, and focus the military on training, readiness, discipline and combat capability. He noted he has already ordered the services to eliminate unnecessary senior posts and believes the previous system contained too many overlapping command and administrative levels.

This is one of the military reorganizations Hegseth has pursued since taking office in 2025. In May 2025 he demanded each service cut at least 10% of its general and senior officer billets, with a 20% cut for National Guard senior officers, and to remove redundant or unnecessary organizational layers. The new plan raises the overall reduction target to 20%.

Hegseth also linked the reform to his criticism of “woke” culture and DEI (Diversity, Equity and Inclusion) policies. In his speech he said the Pentagon is no longer a “woke department” and that the military’s primary mission should refocus on training, readiness, accountability, discipline and lethality. He added that personnel who previously championed such culture and cannot align with the new direction have been removed from related positions.

However, cutting general and senior officer slots is not the same as DEI policy. Hegseth’s administration argues that streamlining the senior hierarchy boosts efficiency and combat readiness, while critics contend that the recent wave of senior officer departures, position reshuffles and stalled promotions may reflect both policy direction and loyalty considerations.

In his address Hegseth used strong language to describe the culture he wants to build, emphasizing that service members should prioritize combat ability, physical fitness, discipline and readiness rather than spending large amounts of time on social and cultural issues. The remarks drew criticism from Democrats, some former defense officials and military experts who worry that political factors are overly influencing personnel and command structures, potentially affecting professionalism and senior‑level stability.

Hegseth and his supporters argue that the long‑term expansion of senior leadership, excessive administrative procedures, and policies unrelated to combat have increased the military’s operating costs. He contends that more resources should be directed toward actual warfighting readiness instead of maintaining an oversized senior command structure.

Recent changes to DEI policy in the U.S. military also form an important backdrop to this reform. During the Obama administration, the “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” policy was officially ended, with legislation repealed in 2010 and taking effect on September 20, 2011, allowing gay and bisexual service members to serve openly. This reform was a major shift in personnel policy but is not identical to today’s DEI initiatives.

After President Biden took office, transgender service policies were further adjusted. On January 25, 2021, Biden signed an executive order directing the Department of Defense and the Department of Homeland Security to restore the ability of qualified transgender individuals to serve. Since then, the military has continued to advance personnel policies and training related to gender identity and inclusion.

The article’s reference to Rear Admiral Rachel Levine requires clarification. Levine became a four‑star admiral in the U.S. Public Health Service Commissioned Corps in 2021, which is part of the Public Health Service, not the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps or Space Force, so she cannot be called the “first transgender four‑star general in the U.S. military.”

After Donald Trump returned to the White House, his administration quickly reversed several of the previous administration’s military personnel and DEI policies. The Trump administration ordered a review of DEI‑related policies, training and programs and imposed stricter limits on transgender service eligibility. Hegseth became a key executor of this policy shift.

Since taking office, Hegseth has driven multiple senior‑level personnel changes. Public data show that by early September at least 20 generals, admirals and senior civilian officials in the Department of Defense had been dismissed, forced out or resigned, including senior officers from the Army, Navy and Air Force, leading to a noticeable reshuffle at the Pentagon’s top tier.

In April of this year, Hegseth also demanded that Army Chief of Staff Randy George and other senior officers step down. George had been slated to serve until 2027; the timing of the change came while U.S. forces were still engaged in operations against Iran, raising external concerns about senior‑level stability and personnel decision standards.

In addition to cutting senior officer billets, on September 30 Hegseth announced the creation of a new Autonomous Warfare Command, a four‑star operational command tasked with accelerating the deployment of drones, autonomous systems and robotics across the services. The Pentagon hopes this will speed up the military application of AI, autonomous weapons and robotic systems.

Hegseth also announced the establishment of a Religious Affairs Office and proposed new base construction and increased energy‑self‑sufficiency for installations. Moreover, the Pentagon will launch a 120‑day future‑warfare research initiative to examine the impact of AI, autonomous weapons, robotics and other emerging technologies on future battlefields.

The high‑level reshuffle has drawn congressional attention. Some lawmakers argue that replacing senior commanders while the U.S. is engaged in the Iran conflict and other global missions could create uncertainty in the command structure; supporters of the reform say the military’s senior bureaucracy has become overly large, and trimming senior officer slots can reduce administrative burdens and shift resources to combat units.

To date, Hegseth has offered no evidence that DEI policies themselves have degraded combat effectiveness, so the claim that “DEI is causing a decline in U.S. military capability” is mainly a criticism from the Trump administration and Hegseth’s camp rather than a universally accepted military conclusion. Opponents contend that linking senior personnel changes directly to political ideology could erode the traditional separation between civilian leadership and military professionalism.

Another key thrust of the reform is synchronizing senior personnel adjustments with the development of new warfighting technologies. While cutting some traditional senior posts, Hegseth is simultaneously standing up the Autonomous Warfare Command, indicating the Pentagon’s intent to reduce certain bureaucratic layers while increasing the share of AI, drones and autonomous systems in the combat force.

In terms of scale, the 851 active‑duty generals and senior officers represent less than 1% of the over 1.3 million active service members, yet these positions command the major services, combat commands and large formations, so any large‑scale adjustment could affect the chain of command and promotion system.

Hegseth describes the effort as “accountability” rather than the “purge” label used by critics. He says the military has already completed roughly a 10% reduction in senior personnel and will now eliminate another 10% of officer slots to achieve a total 20% shrinkage of the senior structure. Under the current plan, the changes are expected to continue, with some positions possibly finalized by January 1 2027.

The core controversy of this reform is therefore not solely DEI but how the U.S. military can trim its senior bureaucratic apparatus, adjust personnel systems and redirect resources toward new warfighting capabilities while preserving a professional command structure. Hegseth hopes the overhaul will produce a force that emphasizes readiness and combat power, but the actual impact and the long‑term effects of massive senior‑level personnel changes on readiness and command stability remain to be seen.

美國8月通貨膨脹漲幅低於預期及7月數據下修，降低美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)本月再加息的迫切性，但中東戰爭持續推高全球物價，推動美國十年和三十年期公債收益率分別創2007年和2002年6月以來新高，週四支撐美元徘徊兩個月高位；此外，標準普爾(S&P)全球調查日本9月製造業採購經理人指數(PMI)降至六個月最低54.1，並據日本央行(BOJ)短觀調查，日本第三季大型製造業企業信心指數創2018年3月以來最高達正24，但大型非製造業景氣判斷指數五季以來首次下降至正35，同時企業預計未來一年消費者物價平均漲2.6%，低於三個月前預期，而且據BOJ的9月會議意見摘要，多數決策者均認為有必要加快升息步伐，但九人組成的政策委員會中有兩位鴿派成員對9月加息持異議，市場認為BOJ可能不會在10月連續升息的觀點打壓日圓，推動美元兌日圓自157.31低點上漲。

據日本電視台播出錄製採訪顯示，首相高市早苗誓言提升經濟競爭力來支撐日圓，但美國上周初請失業金人數降至19.7萬人及8月建築支出升0.9%優於預期，縱使S&P全球與供應管理協會(ISM)發布美國9月製造業PMI分別降至55.9及54.5，而且FED副主席杰斐遜與明尼亞波利斯聯邦儲備銀行總裁卡什卡利相繼稱不確定FED下一步行動，仍推升美元兌日圓至158.45高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.30-50，支撐於157.20-40。
◆EUR/USD

昨日澳洲央行(RBA)表示家庭和銀行有能力應對房價下跌和經濟衰退，但地產諮詢公司Cotality公布澳洲9月房屋價格較前月跌1.1%，為連續六個月下滑，料陷入三十年來最嚴重低迷，並據澳洲統計局數據顯示，因數據中心設備進口再度大幅增加，抵消黃金出口的強勁反彈，8月貿易順差縮減至4.95億澳幣不及預期，而且澳洲截至8月的三個月職位空缺數降0.9%至去年初以來最低，令澳幣承壓，拖累歐元兌美元自1.1336高點走低。
隨著S&P全球9月製造業PMI調查，法國連續兩個月擴張至50.6及德國升至53.9，歐元區則逾四年來最快上升達52.9，但油價上漲和通貨膨脹衝擊經濟，投資人大舉拋售歐洲資產，而且報導稱中國暫停燃料出口及美軍增兵中東，在美國就業報告前，重創歐元兌美元至1.1214低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1240-60，支撐於1.1150-70。
◆GBP/USD

週四全英房屋抵押貸款協會調查英國9月房屋價格較前月跌0.2%及較上年同期降至0.8%，而且美國公債收益率攀升提振美元，引英鎊兌美元自1.3272高點下跌。隨著中東戰事持久導致油價每桶100美元以上恐帶來長期影響，並據S&P全球英國9月製造業PMI升至51.9及工廠投入成本漲幅為6月以來最大，但製造業產出增速創3月以來新低，而且英國央行(BOE)委員曼恩認為應對伊朗戰爭衝擊不果斷加劇政策不確定性，打擊英鎊兌美元至1.3177低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3185-1.3205，支撐於1.3070-90。

items.title: Fed蘿根：至少應再升息2碼  並需連番升息來抵銷去年秋季降息
items.title_en: Fed Logan: At Least Two More Rate Hikes Needed, With Consecutive Increases to Counter Last Fall’s Cuts
paras: 達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)週四(1日)表示，聯準會(Fed)至少應該再升息2碼(50個基點)。
她在一場演講中話道：「聯準會的政策立場一直偏離正軌，聯準會應該升息，目標至少為加50個基點。且至少需要進一步升息數次，才能抵銷去年秋季的降息，因為若無較高的利率，通膨無法達到聯準會2%目標。」
蘿根還表示，長債殖利率走高顯示市場參與者預期未來利率水準更高，她將密切關注美債殖利率走勢並評估其對經濟、融資成本和貨幣政策的影響。
她認為，長端殖利率上升未必只來自政策預期，也可能反映期限溢價走高。若投資人要求更高補償、期限溢價上升，會自然推高借貸成本，在一定程度上取代Fed緊縮，進而降低進一步升息的必要性。
但蘿根強調，Fed不會僅因長債殖利率上漲就預設行動，而會結合通膨、就業與金融環境判斷。
蘿根曾在2023年的演講中詳細介紹她所參考的各類美債市場模型。她表示，會持續觀察殖利率走勢以及經濟其他方面，以此判斷何種利率水準能對經濟形成一定抑制效果。
蘿根今年在聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)是擁有投票資格的決策官員，但作為地區聯準銀行總裁，她的言論仍被視為政策方向的重要參考。
paras_en: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said on Thursday (the 1st) that the Federal Reserve should raise rates by at least two more increments, equivalent to 50 basis points.

In her speech she said, “The Fed’s policy stance has been off track; the Fed should raise rates, targeting at least an additional 50 basis points. Several more hikes will be needed to offset the rate cuts made last autumn, because without higher rates inflation cannot reach the Fed’s 2% goal.”

Logan also noted that rising long‑term bond yields indicate market participants expect higher future rates, and she will closely monitor U.S. Treasury yield movements and assess their impact on the economy, financing costs, and monetary policy.

She argued that the rise in long‑end yields may not stem solely from policy expectations; it could also reflect a higher term premium. If investors demand greater compensation and term premiums rise, borrowing costs will naturally increase, partially substituting for Fed tightening and reducing the need for further hikes.
Nonetheless, Logan emphasized that the Fed will not act solely on higher long‑term yields; decisions will be based on a combination of inflation, employment, and financial‑market conditions.

Logan previously detailed the various Treasury‑market models she follows in a 2023 speech, saying she will continue to watch yield trends and other economic indicators to gauge what level of rates can exert a sufficient restraining effect on the economy.

Logan is a voting member of the Federal Open Market Committee this year, and although she serves as a regional Fed president, her comments are still regarded as an important reference for the direction of policy.

items.title_en: New York FX: Global Bond Sell‑off Boosts Dollar, Euro Under Pressure
paras: 美元周四(1日)上漲，兌歐元周四升至17個月高點，全球債券遭遇拋售，推動美國與歐洲政府公債殖利率升至新高，同時油價上漲也加劇市場對通膨的擔憂。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.51%，盤中一度升至2025年4月以來最高水準。
截至9月底，美元兌一籃子貨幣已連續第6季上漲，創下2022年以來最長連漲紀錄。2022年期間，美國升息速度快於其他國家。
歐元兌美元跌破1.1215美元，為2025年5月以來首次。過去幾個月美元持續走強，部分原因是美國公債殖利率出現自1994年以來最大單季升幅。
歐元兌美元下跌0.77%，至1.12433美元。歐元9月下跌近2.5%，創下2025年7月以來最大單月跌幅。
NatWest Markets G10外匯策略主管Brian Daingerfield表示，「殖利率走高是多項因素共同作用的結果，尤其是市場對財政政策的擔憂，包括法國債券市場出現部分疲弱跡象，可能正蔓延至全球市場。此外，市場也持續擔心能源價格與通膨走高。」
他指出，「市場預期各國央行將持續收緊政策，其中也包括聯準會(Fed)。過去幾天，在我們昨天公布的部分個人消費支出(PCE)數據公布後，這種預期有所回落。但整體而言，市場普遍認為聯準會可能還會進一步收緊政策。」
美國10年期公債殖利率當日升至2002年以來最高水準，最新下跌5.65個基點至5.237%。
歐元兌日元與瑞郎也同步下跌，兌英鎊則勉強維持正值。法國政府財政狀況不穩引發市場擔憂，推動法國公債殖利率飆升至14年新高。德國指標性公債也遭到拋售。
Klarity FX總監Amo Sahota表示，「幾周以來，美元一直持續走強，而市場時不時就會出現一個新的敘事，為美元提供進一步上漲的動力。」
「但我認為最新的這個因素可能是最令人擔憂的，也就是歐洲市場出現恐慌。法國債務實在太高，加上法國與德國之間的利差擴大，讓所有人都感到不安。歐元因此大幅走弱，而且跌勢再次加速。」
周三公布數據顯示，美國8月通膨增幅低於預期，且7月數據遭到下修，降低了市場對聯準會本月升息的預期。不過，歐元區通膨大幅上升，凸顯能源價格上漲持續對全球經濟構成威脅。
全球債券在9月出現多年來最大單月跌幅，推動殖利率走高，原因包括政府財政狀況惡化、公債發行供給過多，以及通膨升溫等多項因素。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.49%，至1.32美元。英鎊9月下跌2.1%，但兌歐元持穩。歐元兌英鎊約報85.18便士，為6月底以來最低水準。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Thursday (the 1st), reaching a 17‑month high against the euro as a global bond sell‑off pushed U.S. and European government bond yields to fresh highs, while higher oil prices heightened market inflation concerns.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.51% and at one point hit its highest level since April 2025.

As of the end of September, the dollar against a basket of currencies has risen for six consecutive quarters, marking the longest streak of gains since 2022. During 2022, U.S. rate hikes outpaced those of other countries.

The euro fell below $1.1215, its first dip below that level since May 2025. The dollar’s recent strength over the past months has been partly driven by a quarterly surge in U.S. Treasury yields—the largest since 1994.
The euro slipped 0.77% to $1.12433. In September the euro fell nearly 2.5%, the biggest monthly decline since July 2025.

NatWest Markets G10 FX strategy head Brian Daingerfield said, “Higher yields are the result of multiple factors, especially market worries about fiscal policy, including signs of weakness in the French bond market that could be spreading globally. In addition, markets remain concerned about rising energy prices and inflation.”

He added, “Markets expect central banks worldwide to keep tightening policy, including the Fed. In the past few days, after some personal consumption expenditures (PCE) data we released yesterday, that expectation eased a bit. Overall, however, the market broadly believes the Fed may still tighten further.”
U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose to their highest level since 2002 on the day, later easing 5.65 basis points to 5.237%.

The euro also fell against the yen and the Swiss franc, while it barely stayed positive against the pound. Concerns over France’s fiscal situation have spooked markets, sending French bond yields to a 14‑year high, and German benchmark bonds have also been sold off.
Klarity FX director Amo Sahota said, “For weeks the dollar has been consistently strong, and the market keeps coming up with new narratives that give the dollar further upside.”

“But I think the latest factor may be the most worrying—panic in European markets. French debt is simply too high, and the widening spread between France and Germany is unsettling everyone. The euro has therefore weakened sharply, and the decline is accelerating again.”

Wednesday’s data showed U.S. August inflation rose less than expected, and July’s figure was revised down, lowering market expectations for a Fed rate hike this month. However, euro‑area inflation surged, underscoring that rising energy prices continue to threaten the global economy.

Global bonds posted their biggest monthly drop in years in September, pushing yields higher. The drivers include deteriorating fiscal positions, an oversupply of sovereign debt, and warming inflation, among other factors.
The pound fell 0.49% to $1.32. It is down 2.1% in September but held steady against the euro. The euro‑pound rate is about 85.18 pence, the lowest since the end of June.
The yen weakened 0.41% to ¥158.07 per dollar.
The Australian dollar slipped to $0.69040, a three‑month low, after domestic inflation data came in below expectations.

items.title_en: Dual Blow from Rising Inflation and Interest Rates Sends Euro to 17‑Month Low
paras: 受高油價與通膨打擊區域經濟、加上政治不確定性升溫影響，歐元兌美元匯率周四(1日)跌至 17 個月新低，跌破 1.13 美元關卡。
9 月份歐元累計重挫近 2.5%，創下 2025 年 7 月以來最大單月跌幅。同時，歐元兌日元與瑞士法郎同步走弱，法國公債殖利率飆升至 14 年新高，德國指標債券也面臨拋售壓力。
對於歐元的疲軟表現，荷蘭合作銀行(Rabobank)外匯策略主管 Jane Foley 指出，經濟成長風險長期籠罩歐元。Foley 表示：「儘管歐洲央行是G10中最早升息的央行之一，且市場預期將再度升息，但歐元仍無法獲得支撐力道。」
她補充，歐元主要受到多頭部位累積過高、歐洲作為能源進口國的隱憂，以及延伸至明年的政治不確定性(如法國大選與德國右翼政黨崛起)所拖累。
相較之下，受惠於美債殖利率急升，美元指數創下自 2022 年以來最長的連續六季上漲紀錄。澳洲國民銀行(National Australia Bank)外匯策略主管 Ray Attrill 表示：「目前美元對 10 年期美國公債殖利率變化的敏感度，高於對聯準會(Fed)下次升息時點的定價。」
Attrill 指出，殖利率持續上升對美元構成支撐，若殖利率升至轉折點並衝擊股市，美元也能發揮避險效益。
paras_en: The euro fell to a 17‑month low against the dollar on Thursday (the 1st), slipping below the 1.13 USD mark, as regional economies are hit by high oil prices and inflation, and political uncertainty heats up.

In September the euro accumulated a near‑2.5% decline, the biggest monthly drop since July 2025. At the same time the euro weakened against the yen and the Swiss franc, French government bond yields surged to a 14‑year high, and German benchmark bonds faced selling pressure.

Regarding the euro’s weakness, Jane Foley, head of foreign‑exchange strategy at Rabobank, said the risk to economic growth has long cast a shadow over the currency. Foley noted, “Even though the ECB is one of the earliest G10 central banks to raise rates and markets expect another hike, the euro still lacks support.”

She added that the euro is being dragged down by an overly large buildup of long‑position bets, Europe’s vulnerability as an energy‑importing region, and political uncertainty extending into next year, such as the French election and the rise of right‑wing parties in Germany.

In contrast, the dollar index has set a record for the longest six‑quarter streak of gains since 2022, helped by a sharp rise in U.S. Treasury yields. Ray Attrill, head of foreign‑exchange strategy at National Australia Bank, said, “Right now the dollar’s sensitivity to changes in the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield is greater than its pricing of the Fed’s next rate‑hike timing.”
Attrill pointed out that continued yield increases underpin the dollar; if yields reach a turning point and hit equity markets, the dollar can also serve as a safe‑haven asset.

日銀在9月決策會議中，將基準利率調升至1.25%，創1995年以來最高，日銀總裁當時表示，央行政策進入新的階段，重點將放在防止通膨超標，這番話為進一步升息敞開大門。
日銀在周四公布的9月會議意見摘要中，確認政策重點已轉向防止通膨超過目標。與會委員還指出，中性利率可能高於目前所料，許多企業認為迄今升息帶來的影響有限，而且希望在較早階段進一步升息。
不過，市場對日銀10月升息的預期反而降溫。利率交換市場定價顯示，截至10月30日的升息機率在周四上午降至略低於20%，前一日一度超過30%。針對12月會議時市場則已完全反映一次升息。
日本政府公債(JGB)殖利率周四上升，較長天期殖利率漲幅更明顯，顯示市場擔心日銀升息速度可能不足以抑制通膨。
Gaitame.com Research Institute資深外匯分析師Takuya Kanda說：「雖然會議中有許多鷹派意見，但鷹派程度仍不足以強化連續升息的預期。若美元兌日元升破158，市場對干預的擔憂可能抑制美元進一步升值空間。」

2張反對票的意義

值得注意的是，並非所有決策官員都認為升息條件正在成熟。日銀九名理事中，淺田統一郎(Toichiro Asada)與佐藤綾乃(Ayano Sato)兩名偏鴿派理事對9月升息投下反對票。
因此，周四出爐的意見摘要，可能有納入一些兩人主張維持利率不變的理由，例如警告日本消費表現疲弱，以及服務通膨升勢溫和。
出席會議的日本內閣府代表也要求日銀「仔細檢視過去升息的累積影響」，顯示日本政府擔心升息可能對經濟造成衝擊。雖然意見摘要並未公開發言者身分，但日本經濟再生相城內實(Minoru Kiuchi)代表內閣府出席9月會議，而他被視為高市政府的再通膨政策支持者。

Fed相較更鷹派

知情人士透露，9月貨幣政策會議後，由於日銀未針對未來升息速度提供更明確指引，日元曾應聲走弱，而日本金融局曾在紐約交易時段進行「利率檢查」。
日本財務省周三公布的數據顯示，在涵蓋9月大部分時間的最新單月資料期間，日本並未進場干預匯市。
另一方面，美國聯準會(Fed)官員9月則是一致投票升息，並釋出支持今年再升息一次、明年再升息一次的訊號。
澳洲聯邦銀行(Commonwealth Bank of Australia)策略師Samara Hammoud說：「日銀要展現足夠鷹派的立場，門檻很高。日銀近期出現分歧決策，加上Fed立場更加鷹派，因此除非日銀提供更明確的前瞻指引，否則日銀升息預期不太可能為日元提供太多支撐。」
由於美國周三公布的個人消費支出(PCE)通膨數據比市場預期溫和，市場對美國升息的預期稍稍降溫，可能減輕日銀本月升息的壓力。若日元過度貶值，將推升進口成本，因此日銀原本可能需要透過升息避免日元出現不利跌勢。
然而，日銀面臨的升息壓力仍高於其他央行，因為目前基準利率仍接近日本名目中性利率預估區間1.1-2.5%的下緣。中性利率指的是既不抑制、也不刺激經濟成長的利率水準。

items.title: AI晶片需求持續高歌猛進！韓9月出口額首破1200億美元 力拼今年突破1兆美元
items.title_en: AI Chip Demand Keeps Soaring! South Korea’s September Export Value Tops $120 Billion, Aiming for $1 Trillion This Year
paras: 在AI半導體需求看似無止盡的推動下，南韓單月出口額首次突破1200億美元，該國產業通商資源部今(1)日指出，受晶片出貨量激增帶動，9月出口額年增83.5%至創紀錄的1209億美元，按工作日調整後更成長104.9%。
數據顯示，南韓9月半導體出口額首次突破600億美元大關，年增逾兩倍至603億美元，再創歷史新高，成為拉動整體出口的火車頭。
儘管當月受假日影響工作日減少，出口增速仍高於8月的68.7%，也超越65.4%的市場預期。今年前三季出口額累計達8145億美元，首次突破8000億美元關卡。
被視為AI需求風向指標的南韓貿易數據表明，在AI基礎設施投資持續湧入之際，晶片強勁需求幾無減退跡象。
南韓9月進口額則年增26%至710.9億美元，單月貿易順差達498.5億美元，刷新6月創下的359.1億美元前高。
晶片熱潮也改變南韓政府財政狀況，今年稅收有望達到創紀錄的478.6兆韓元(約3530億美元)，年增28%，主要受半導體企業利潤、特別股息、股市活躍及消費復甦推動。
專家指出，出口表現強勁將改善南韓外部收支，並可能支撐韓元升值，抑制輸入性通脹，讓南韓央行(BOK在下次升息時擁有更大彈性。
paras_en: Driven by seemingly endless AI semiconductor demand, South Korea’s monthly export value broke the $120 billion mark for the first time, with the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy noting that a surge in chip shipments pushed September exports up 83.5% year‑on‑year to a record $120.9 billion, or a 104.9% increase when adjusted for working days.

Data show that South Korea’s September semiconductor export value surpassed the $60 billion threshold for the first time, more than doubling year‑on‑year to $60.3 billion and setting a new historic high, making it the engine driving overall export growth.

Even though the month saw fewer working days due to holidays, the export growth rate remained higher than August’s 68.7% and beat market expectations of 65.4%; cumulative exports for the first three quarters reached $814.5 billion, crossing the $800 billion milestone for the first time.
South Korea’s trade data, seen as a barometer of AI demand, indicate that as AI infrastructure investment continues to flow in, strong chip demand shows little sign of waning.

South Korea’s September imports rose 26% year‑on‑year to $71.09 billion, giving the country a monthly trade surplus of $49.85 billion, a new high that eclipses the previous peak of $35.91 billion set in June.

The chip boom is also reshaping the government’s fiscal picture, with this year’s tax revenue expected to hit a record 478.6 trillion won (about $353 billion), up 28% year‑on‑year, driven mainly by semiconductor company profits, special dividends, active equity markets and a consumption recovery.

Experts say the strong export performance will improve South Korea’s external balance, could support a stronger won and curb imported inflation, giving the Bank of Korea more flexibility in its next rate‑hike decision.

據消息人士表示，日本央行(BOJ)預計未來可能以更快和更頻繁的步調升息，以提前防範通貨膨脹超標風險，加速美元兌日圓跌勢至156.35低點。隨後美國公布8月個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數較前月漲0.3%不及預期及商品貿易逆差擴大至1,326億美元，但ADP全國就業報告顯示美國9月民間就業崗位增加9萬個，並在第二季消費支出終值勁升3.8%推動下，國內生產總值(GDP)環比年率終值成長2.2%高於預期，而且9月芝加哥採購經理人指數(PMI)升至58.8優於預估值，突顯美國通貨膨脹溫和但消費強勁，FED年內仍可能加息，激美元兌日圓收復失地。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於157.20-40，阻力於158.20-40。
◆EUR/USD
昨日數據顯示澳洲服裝和旅遊費用下降抵消燃料成本飆升，8月消費者物價指數(CPI)與核心通貨膨脹截尾均值分別較前月漲0.4%及0.2%不及預期，年通貨膨脹率則升至4.0%，但降低對澳洲央行(RBA)短期內再加息的臆測，衝擊澳幣跌至九周新低，而且紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)未如市場利率定價預期般鷹派壓抑紐元，拖累歐元兌美元滑落1.1322低點。
隨後法國公布9月消費者物價調和指數(HICP)初值較上年同期漲3.4%超過預期及義大利9月通貨膨脹率躍升至4.1%，德國9月CPI與HICP初值則均較去年同期升3.3%高於預估值，突顯歐元區主要經濟體通貨膨脹率飆升，加大ECB再加息的壓力，提振歐元兌美元至 1.1380 高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1290-1.1310，阻力於1.1370-90。
◆GBP/USD

週三據萊斯銀行集團月度調查，英國9月企業信心指數跌至去年4月以來最低正41%，並顯示伊朗戰爭推高成本，對全球經濟前景看法更悲觀，打擊英鎊兌美元至1.3219低點。隨後英國公布第二季GDP增長0.4%高於預期，且截至6月的三個月，人均實質家庭可支配所得按季成長1.0%，為2024年底以來最大增幅，同時第二季企業投資較上年同期大幅上修至5.2%及剔除貴金屬貿易後經常帳赤字收窄至經濟產出五年最低1.4%，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3311高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3230-50，阻力於1.3320-40。

U.S. President Trump denied media reports that he was willing to ease sanctions and unfreeze funds in exchange for Iranian concessions on its nuclear program. The market continues to doubt whether the Iran conflict can be resolved, pushing oil prices higher on Wednesday, supporting the dollar near its year‑high. However, New York Fed President Williams made dovish comments, prompting the market to cut its large bets on an October Fed rate hike, limiting dollar gains. In addition, Japan reported August retail sales up 2.7% year‑on‑year and industrial production down 1.7% month‑on‑month, both missing forecasts. Nikkei reported that Japanese Prime Minister Kishida will pledge in next week’s policy speech to respond flexibly to any unexpected developments in the economy or financial markets, and as funds flow back to Japan before the end of the first half of the fiscal year and Japanese investors and exporters sell foreign currency to buy yen, the dollar/yen pair fell from its 157.52 high.

According to sources, the Bank of Japan may raise rates faster and more frequently in the future to pre‑empt inflation risks, accelerating the dollar/yen decline toward a low of 156.35. The U.S. then released August personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index up 0.3% month‑on‑month, missing expectations, and the goods trade deficit widened to $132.6 billion. However, the ADP national employment report showed private payrolls added 90,000 jobs in September, and Q2 consumption spending surged 3.8% year‑over‑year, driving GDP to a 2.2% month‑over‑month annualized gain, above forecasts. September Chicago PMI rose to 58.8, beating estimates, highlighting mild inflation but strong consumption, leaving the Fed likely to keep raising rates this year and allowing the dollar/yen to recover. The dollar/yen is expected to find support at 157.20‑157.40 and resistance at 158.20‑158.40 today.
